# Healthcare Ecosystem — PROJECT_STATUS

**Last updated:** 2026-08-29  
**Status:** active / RAIM SMILE current operator accepted / operator portability accepted / partnership network owner-approved / qualified marketplace and partner pilots gated  
**Phase:** RAIMOV Stage B public live; Stage A protected; RAIM SMILE operating products, partnerships and marketplace preimplementation

## Summary

RAIMOV DENTAL Stage B public strategic platform is live at `https://raimovdental.com/ru/`. Stage A remains protected at `/stage-a/`. Patient-facing, partner and marketplace releases remain separately gated.

DEC-858 keeps RAIM SMILE as the permanent brand protocol of the Raimov clinical school/methodology without promising personal treatment by Atabek.

DEC-859 records the revised commercial architecture:

- Expert Dental Studio is the **current medical operator in Bishkek**, not permanent exclusive operator or owner of RAIM SMILE;
- RAIM SMILE may change operator or connect several registry-approved operators;
- future routing modes are `DESIGNATED_OPERATOR`, `QUALIFIED_ROTATION` and `QUALIFIED_LEAD_MARKETPLACE`;
- highest commercial bid may decide only inside an eligible operator pool after licence, program, quality, capacity, privacy, disclosure and patient-consent gates;
- medical data never enters a bid round;
- qualified marketplace remains `DESIGNED_NOT_ACTIVE` pending counsel, contracts and implementation.

The RAIM SMILE Partnership Network is owner-approved strategy and a first-class acquisition/product layer. It uses co-branded privileges, verified member/VIP eligibility, Private Dental Concierge, Gulbara as the first multilingual non-clinical Partner & VIP Coordinator, partner-specific attribution and measurable distribution contracts. Named partners, public SLA and benefit cohorts remain gated.

**RAIM SMILE · SmileCare 12** is the owner-approved public name for the unchanged current Expert Dental benefit binding (`DEC-861`). It does not activate expanded v2 plans, new prices, checkout, partner funding or cross-operator portability.

Second Opinion and Treatment Coordinator contracts are designed, not active. Public intake and remote Kazakhstan remain behind clinic/medical/legal/privacy/CRM/capacity gates.

Evidence for the existing public Stage B: `docs/audits/raimov/releases/public-v1/PRODUCTION_CUTOVER.md`.

## Decisions and gates

- DEC-742 — future investor-first direction.
- DEC-743 — Stage A strategic presentation.
- DEC-858 — permanent brand protocol, no personal-treatment promise.
- DEC-859 — current operator, replaceability, qualified multi-operator marketplace and separate platform economics.
- Partnership Network SSOT — co-branded privilege/product instead of flyer swaps; recurring measurable distribution required.
- Current routing — `DESIGNATED_OPERATOR / expert_dental_studio`.
- Marketplace — `DESIGNED_NOT_ACTIVE`.
- Partner pilots — `PARTNER_PILOT_GATED` until agreement, capacity, legal/privacy, operator and source-attribution gates pass.
- SmileCare 12 — public display name approved; current SKU ids/prices/benefits unchanged, expanded v2 remains gated.
- Per-lead/bidding compensation — blocked until dedicated counsel gates pass.
- Operator transfer — blocked until registry, Commercial Schedule, disclosure/consent, DPA and transition smoke pass.
- Second Opinion / Treatment Coordinator — `DESIGNED_NOT_ACTIVE` until activation checklists pass.
- Public patient cutover — legal/privacy/evidence/CRM/capacity/release gates open.

## Explicit boundary

The current-binding SmileCare 12 naming cutover is authorised by DEC-861. The strategy does not authorise complimentary cohorts, expanded plans, named partner claims, public Concierge SLA, live marketplace bidding, public paid-ranking claims, transfer to multiple clinics, medical-data broadcasting, per-lead invoicing, operator replacement, remote care or cross-border transfer.
